Food is resold only once its measure is settled; measuring brings blessing; Jabir's measured dates paid his father's debts undiminished, and the Prophet prayed for Medina's mudd and sa.
The Prophet's Sa' was a later Mudd and a third; Ibn Umar paid Zakat al-Fitr and oath expiations by the Prophet's Mudd; the Prophet asked Allah to bless Medina's measures.
The Sa' measure in the Prophet's time equalled a Mudd and a third of a later Mudd, and he asked Allah to bless the measures of Medina's people.
